text:
michael_ops: Heads up - after last night's EFA/OFED push in euc-west2 we're seeing some NCCL allreduce jobs falling back to TCP and throughput is ~40% lower on several GPU pools :thinking:
li_devinfra: saw that on staging too. metric spikes at 03:12 UTC, lots of IB QP retransmits in kernel logs.
tara_sre: any idea which package version was rolled? buildbot: patch-job #4521 applied efa-stack 1.22.0 and mlx5-fw 16.29.1020 to a subset of nodes.
michael_ops: yep that matches. running `nvidia/cuda` didn't change; CUDA 12.1 still same. suspect RDMA transport regression.
jordan_net: quick grep from one host:
```
[  180.123456] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: mlx5 Devlink: mlx5_fw 16.29.1020
[  180.123458] rdma: mlx5: QP mlx5_qp 0x1a3c: retrans timeout, retry exceeded
[  180.123459] rdma: mlx5: falling back to IB_RDMACM -> TCP
```
li_devinfra: also seeing PMTU discovery warnings and some path MTU blackholes on certain switches. `ifconfig` MTU still 9000 but ICMP fragmentation messages suppressed.
tara_sre: relevant NCCL log excerpt:
```
INFO NCCL Allreduce: using transport: tcp (rdma fallback)
WARN NCCL: connection reset during setup
```
michael_ops: rollouts: only 24 of 250 nodes got the firmware before we paused, so noisy but limited impact. can we quickly gather list of affected nodes by devpool label?
li_devinfra: running `rg` across nodes for firmware string, will post list. preliminary: euc-west2-gpu-{a1,a3,a5,a7}.
jordan_net: short-term mitigation: we can force NCCL to prefer shm/tcp and avoid rdma transport to stabilize latency-sensitive jobs: set `NCCL_PROTO=LL`? (actually needs testing)
tara_sre: we had a flag in k8s job spec previously: `env: - name: NCCL_DISABLE_NET - value: "1"` for critical job class, but that bumps CPU cost. Not ideal long-term.
buildbot: rollback playbook available: `ansible-playbook playbooks/firmware-rollback.yml --limit euc-west2-gpu-* --tags mlx5-fw` but needs approval from infra leads.
michael_ops: before rollback can we try kernel param tweaks or mlx5 module options? any known workarounds?
jordan_net: options to try on one node:
```
# disable GSI slowpath coalesce
echo 0 > /sys/module/mlx5_core/parameters/sq_psn_check
# or toggle RDMAV_FC
echo 1 > /sys/module/rdma_ucm/parameters/rdmav_fc
```
(need to confirm exact param names on kernel 6.3)
li_devinfra: tried toggling `RDMAV_FC=1` on a canary - reduced retransmits but not eliminated. Also tried `ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off gro off` and saw modest improvement.
tara_sre: can we capture `ib_get_counters` and `ibv_devinfo` output for 3 impacted hosts and attach to the incident ticket? michael_ops: yes I'll paste them here in a sec.
michael_ops: host euc-west2-gpu-a3-12 logs:
```
# ibv_devinfo -v
hca_id: mlx5_0
transport: InfiniBand (0)
firmware_version: 16.29.1020
```
and counters show increasing `tx_err` and `retrans_seg`.
li_devinfra: timeline proposal:
- 04:00 UTC: collect counters + network traces (tcpdump on mlx interface) on canaries
- 05:00 UTC: try kernel param toggles + disable TSO on canaries
- 06:00 UTC: decision - rollback firmware or coordinate vendor patch
michael_ops: costing note: if we disable RDMA or force TCP for all large jobs that's +~25% token cost due to slower throughput (estimates from last test). Need ops approval for cost hit if we go that route.
jordan_net: reached out to vendor support (Mellanox) case #MLO-9982, they asked for `dmesg`, `ibv_devinfo`, and `mlx5_core` logs. Vendor suspecting firmware-driver ABI mismatch after OFED packaging change.
tara_sre: for immediate relief, I will cordon the worst nodes from prod scheduling and keep them for debugging. Can we move in-flight jobs to euc-west2-gpu-b* nodes?
li_devinfra: scheduler will reschedule; I'll add taint `taint=efafw-broken:NoSchedule` on affected nodes.
michael_ops: consensus: collect data, attempt module toggles on two canaries, cordon/taint affected hosts, and hold firmware rollout. rollback only if toggles fail.
buildbot: rollback approval request filed by @michael_ops. Ops lead @li_devinfra must ack to execute.
li_devinfra: ack - proceed with canary experiments first. I'll run the toggles and post results at 05:40 UTC.
jordan_net: one more note — some jobs on Dedicated pools didn't see regression: those are on older mlx5-fw 16.17.x. points to firmware change as likely cause.
tara_sre: good. also create short postmortem template entry while we wait: impact, root cause hypothesis, mitigation, rollback decision window.
michael_ops: adding incident ticket INF-2026-110 to track. I'll paste traces once collected.
li_devinfra: update: after toggles on a3-12 and a3-14 we reduced retransmits by ~60% and NCCL resumed RDMA on one canary. still investigating which option was the key. will test combination of `RDMAV_FC=1` + `ethtool -K`.
michael_ops: thanks. keep updates tight and if any job SLA breaks, start rollback.
